Kits.Name: Techology
Kits.Benefit: You can attempt Skill Tests that call for a Standard Repair Kit without a snag. You can attempt Skill Tests that call for a Limited Repair Kit with ↓1 instead of a Snag and Skill Tests that call for a Restricted Repair kit with ↓3 instead of a Snag. You can take 10 minutes and spend this kit to gain temporary Specialization in Repair for 1 minute, or gain ↑1 for 1 minute on Skill Tests if you're already specialized in Reapair
